entries.6f1f47a1bcb39530: A reportable segment that manufactures and sells gas meters, water meters, flowmeters, and measurement, monitoring and control systems. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales were ¥59,061 million (up 8.9% from the previous year), accounting for almost all of consolidated net sales of ¥59,116 million. In addition to the Company's manufacturing and sales, part of the manufacturing is outsourced to the consolidated subsidiaries Aiseitech Co., Ltd. and Aichi Kisosaki Seiko Co., Ltd. In Vietnam, the consolidated subsidiary Aichi Tokei Denki Vietnam Co., Ltd. carries out manufacturing and sales; in China, the consolidated subsidiary Dalian Aichi Tokei Technology Co., Ltd. and the affiliated company Shenzhen Aichi Sidu Instruments Co., Ltd. do so; and in Taiwan, the affiliated company Taiwan Aichi Instruments Technology Co., Ltd. does so. Packing and transport of products are mainly handled by the consolidated subsidiary Aichi Packing & Transport Co., Ltd. The securities report discloses net sales of this business by field in [Related Information] and [Revenue Recognition], and it was written divided into the following 4 fields.
entries.70433b6cc3f1a2ea: A field that makes gas meters for city gas, LP gas and industrial use, pressure equipment, governor pressure monitoring systems, gas meter-reading systems and more. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, net sales were ¥27,484 million (up 3.8% from the previous year), the largest of the 4 fields. The securities report gives as reasons for the increase that, in LP gas, replacement demand for household LP gas meters entered a recovery phase and products related to the data distribution service "Aichi Cloud" were firm. For city gas, it states that exports to China increased owing to the effect of the joint venture established in April 2024, while the domestic market decreased.
